title: Q-GAP-default-policy-pack: A short default policy pack a buyer can adopt
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:seed/autonomy/default-policy-pack.json
**Status:** open

Gap in component `bootstrap-from-idea`: today the policy is long and written as owner directives. Extract a short default pack (limits, gate list, budget caps) into seed/autonomy/default-policy-pack.json, with the long directives as an overlay.
